spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what goes.
E.
प्रु to go, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be expounded or explained.
E.
प्र before वच to speak, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
Who speaks or declares.
m. (-क्ता)
A teacher, an expounder.
E.
प्र before वच to speak, तृच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A Veda, scripture.
2 Excellent speech or language, eloquence.
3 Teachinge, expounding.
E.
प्र principal, वचन speech.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 A good speaker.
2 To be well or elegantly spoken.
E.
प्र before वच to speak, aff. अनीयर्.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु)
Eloquent.
E.
प्रवचन, and पटु skilful.

m. (-टः)
Wheat.
E.
प्र before वट to divide, aff. अच्.

m. (-टः)
Barley.
E.
प्र and आङ् before वट to encompass. aff. अच्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Declivity, declining, steep.
2 Bent, bowed.
3 Attached or adhering to, filled with, possessed of, endowed with.
4 Curved, crooked.
5

Swift.
6

Generous.
7

Humble, modest.
8 Wasted, decayed.
m. (-णः)
A place where four roads meet.
E.
प्र before वन to sound, &c. aff. अच्.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
1 Speaking to or with, conversing, addressing.
2 Speaking much or well.
3 Arguing, a disputant.
E.
प्र before वद to speak, शतृ aff.

n. (-णं)
Sowing.
E.
प्र before वप to sow, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
A goad.
E.
प्र before अज to go, वी substituted for the root, and aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-याः)
An old man.
E.
प्र past, and वयस् life or age.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Best, most excellent.
n. (-रं)
1 Offspring, descendants.
2 Family, race, kindred.
3 A black sort of kidney bean.
4 Covering, screening.
5 A Muni, who contributes to the continuation of, and credit of a particular caste or tribe of Brahmans.
E.
प्र before वृ to chuse, aff. अप्.

m. (-रः)
Covering, clothing.
E.
प्र before वृ to cover, aff. घञ्; also with अप् aff., and in other senses, प्रवर्.

m. (-रः)
An inclosure, a fence, a hedge.
E.
प्र and आङ् before वृ to surround, aff. अप्.

m. (-रः)
An upper or outer garment, a cloak, a mantle.
E.
प्र before वृ with आङ् prefix, aff. घञ्.

n. (-तं)
A species of the Aṣṭī metre.

m. (-र्गः)
Sacrificial fire.
E.
प्र before वृज to abandon, aff. घञ्.

m. (-र्ग्यः)
An officiating priest.
n. (-र्ग्यं)
A particular ceremony or sacrifice.
E.
प्रवर्ग, and यत् aff.

m. (-र्त्तः)
1 Engaging in, undertaking.
2 Excitement, stimulus.
E.
प्र before वृत to be, घञ् aff.: see प्रवर्त्तन and प्रवृत्ति.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Inciting, stimulating, inducing, who or what sets in action.
m. (-कः)
1 The original instigator of any act, the author, the principal.
2 An arbiter, a judge.
n. (-कं)
The entrance of the first person of the drama on the close of the introduction.
E.
प्र before वृत to be, aff. ण्वुल्.

n. (-नं)
1 Action, business, worldly interest or activity as opposed to abstract contemplation.
2 Fixing, establishing.
3 Engaging in, (any work.)
4

Beginning.
5

Inciting, stimulating.
6 Directing, superintending.
7

Informing.
8

Revolving.
f. (-ना)
Order, permission, the sense of the precative, or qualified imperative tense.
E.
प्र before वृत to be, aff. (-युच्,) fem. aff. टाप्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Engaging in, practising, doing.
2 Being used or employed.
E.
प्र before वृत to be, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Informed, apprized.
2 Stimulated, excited, instigated.
3 Revolving, going round.
4 Made, rendered.
E.
प्र before वृत to be, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
What causes to grow or increase.
n. (-नं)
Increase, augmenting.
E.
प्र before वृध to increase, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Chief, principal, first.
E.
प्र before वृह to increase, aff. अच्.

m. (-की)
1 A snake.
2 One with a variegated girdle.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-मत्)
Residing abroad.
E.
प्र before वस to dwell, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
Dwelling or being abroad or absent.
E.
प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Going abroad, sojourning in a foreign country.
E.
प्र before वस to dwell, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Killing, slaughter.
2 Dwelling abroad, sojourning, lodging.
3 Exile.
E.
प्र away, वस to dwell, or divide, causal v., aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-हः)
1 Going forth, or from a town.
2 One of the seven Vāyus, or winds.
3 Wind, air.
E.
प्र before वह to bear, aff. अच्.

m. (-हः)
1 Stream, flow, continuous passage.
2 Action, occupation, active life.
3 A pond.
4 A swift horse.
f. (-ही)
Sand.
E.
प्र continually, वह to bear, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
A covered car, a litter or carriage for women.
E.
प्र forth, वह to bear, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
1

Bearing.
2

Receiving, enjoying.
E.
प्र before वह to bear, शतृ aff.

f. (-ह्णिः-ह्णी)
A riddle.
E.
प्र before वल्ह to speak, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added: see the next.

f. (-का)
A riddle, an enigma, a conundrum or charade, &c.
E.
प्र before वल्ह to speak or tell, aff. क्वुन्; the conjunct consonants of the root are transposed; also प्रवह्लि and प्रवह्ली, and with कन् added to the latter प्रवह्लीका.

mfn. (-वाक्)
Eloquent, oratorical, speaking, a speaker.
E.
प्र before वच to speak, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Speaking well, eloquent.
E.
प्र before वच to speak, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-णी)
A weaver's shuttle.
E.
प्र before वी to go, aff. ल्युट, fem. aff. ङीप्; also प्रवाणि.

m. (-दः)
1 Rumour, report.
2 Discourse, conversation.
3 Mutual defiance, the conversation of antagonists prior to combat.
E.
प्र spreading, and वाद speech.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Who or what speaks, reports, &c.
E.
प्र before वद to speak, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-पी)
A sower, one who sows seed.
E.
प्र before वप to sow, घिनुण् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 A desirable gift.
2 Prohibition, objection, opposition.
E.
प्र before वृ to chuse, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
1 An upper or outer garment.
2 Any covering.
E.
प्र and आङ् before वृ to cover, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-सः)
A temporary or foreign residence, a habitation away from home.
E.
प्र far or removed, and वास abode.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Expelled, expatriated.
E.
प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
A traveller, a sojourner, one living away from home.
E.
प्रवास a foreign or strange habitation, and इनि aff.; or प्र before वस to dwell, and घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what bears or carries well.
m. (-कः)
An imp, a goblin.
f. (-हिका)
Diarrhoea.
E.
प्र before वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्

ind.
1 At the same time.
2 Above, over; also in this sense, प्रवाहिका ind.

mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्)
Expanding, opening, blossoming.
E.
प्र and वि before कश to go, शतृ aff.

f. (-तिः)
Celebrity, reputation.
E.
प्र and वि prefixed to ख्या to say, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Spread out, expanded.
2 Dishevelled.
E.
प्र and वि before तन to spread, क्त aff.

n. (-णं)
1 War, battle, combat.
2 Tearing, rending, breaking.
3 Tumult, crowd, confusion.
4 Bursting, budding.
E.
प्र and वि prefixed to दॄ to tear to pieces, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Torn, rent, severed.
2 Opened, expanded.
E.
प्र and वि before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Partitioned, divided, separated, shared.
E.
प्र, and विभक्त divided.

m. (-गः)
Division, a part.
E.
प्र, and विभाग division.

m. (-रः)
A yellow fragrant wood.
E.
प्र and वि before रा to get or be, aff. ड.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Best, most excellent.
m. (-रः)
1 A hero, a warrior.
2 A chief, a person of rank or distinction.
E.
प्र preeminent, and वीर a hero.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Apart, separate.
E.
प्र, and विरल distinct.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Lost, removed, fallen or rubbed off.
E.
प्र and वि before लुप to cut, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Separated, detached.
2 Solitary.
E.
प्र, and विविक्त detached.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing or intending to banish.
E.
प्र before व्रज to go, causal desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-षः)
Separation, parting.
E.
प्र and वि negative prefix before श्लिष to unite, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं)
Sad, dejected, spiritless.
E.
प्र much, घिषण्ण dejected.

f. (-षा)
A plant, commonly Atis or Ataich.
E.
प्र against (anti), and विष poison.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Entered, gone in or into.
2 Entered upon, (as an affair,) engaged in.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Skilful, clever, conversant.
E.
प्र implying excellence, and वीणा a lute, or वीण a nominal verb, to play on a lute, aff. अच् or घञ्.

f. (-ता)
Proficiency, skill.
E.
प्रवीण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रवीणत्वं.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Fixed, settled, determined, done.
2 Engaged in, undertaking, occupied by.
3 Begun, beginning.
4 Doing, acting.
5 Undisputed, (as dominion.)
E.
प्र before वृत to be, aff. क्त, form irr.

mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं)
A veil, a wrapper, a cloak or mantle.
adj.
Covered, inclosed, encompassed.
E.
प्र before वृ with आङ् prefix, to cover, aff. क्त.

n. (-र्म्म)
Any act the cause of being born again.
E.
प्रवृत्त, and कर्म्मन् act.

f. (-ता)
Absolute dominion.
E.
प्रवृत्त fixed, चक्र rule, and तल् abstract aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Activity, occupation, active life, as opposed to contemplative devotion; or it is defined to consist of the wish to do, knowledge of the means of success, and accomplishing the desired object.
2 Prosecution, perseverance.
3 Addiction to, predilection for.
4 Practice, conduct.
5 Tidings, intelligence.
6 Continuous flow, stream, current.
7 The juice that exudes from the elephant's temples, when in rut.
8 Oujein, or any holy place.
9 (In arithmetic,) The multiplier.
E.
प्र before वृत to be or abide, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-तिः)
An inclosure, a fence, a bound hedge.
E.
प्र before वृ with आङ prefix, to inclose, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-ज्ञः)
An emissary, an agent, a spy.
E.
प्रवृत्ति news, and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Full grown.
2 Expanded, diffused, spread abroad or dispersed.
3 Swoln, (as a river.)
4 Full, deep, (as a sigh.)
E.
प्र before वृद्ध to increase or grow, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Chief, head, principal.
E.
प्र before विच to distinguish, aff. अच्.

n. (-णं)
Foressing.
E.
प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Foreseen, anticipated.
E.
प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्यन्-क्ष्यन्ती-क्ष्यत्)
Foreseeing, anticipating.
E.
प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, शतृ aff. the first syllable made short.

m. (-टः)
Barley.
E.
प्र before विट to sound, aff. घञ्.

f. (-णिः)
1 The hair twisted, and undecorated, as worn by women in the absence of their husbands.
2 An elephant's [] housings.
E.
प्र before वेणृ to go, aff. इण्; also with डीप् added, प्रवेणी.

f. (-णी)
1 Unornamented hair.
2 An elephant's housings.
E.
see the last.

n. (-णं)
Shaking, agitation, tremulous motion.
E.
प्र before वेपृ to tremble, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-लः)
The yellow variety of kidney bean.
E.
प्र before वेल to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-शः)
1 Intentness on an object, engaging closely in a pursuit or purpose.
2 Entrance.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what enters.
m. (-कः)
1 An inferior actor who announces the entrance of the principal characters.
3 An entry.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 The entrance to a house, the principal door or gate.
2 Entering, entrance.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
A manufactory, a workshop.
E.
प्र before आवेशन entering.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Called or sent in.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, causal v., क्त aff.

ind.
Having sent in, thrown in, or into, &c.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, causal v., ल्युप् aff.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
To be entered, to be pervaded.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, यत् aff.; also प्रवेशनीय.

m. (-ष्टः)
1 An arm.
2 The forearm, or wrist.
3 An elephant's gums.
4 An elephant's housings.
E.
प्र before वेष्ट to encompass, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be entered, to be penetrated or pervaded.
E.
प्र before विश to enter, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Evident, apparent, manifest.
E.
प्र and वि before अञ्ज to spread, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Distressed, pained.
E.
प्र before व्यथ to pain, aff. क्त.

m. (-तः)
1 An ascetic or mendicant.
2 The pupil, or attendant of a Jaina or Bauddha mendicant.
f. (-ता)
1 A female devotee or ascetic.
2 Spikenard, (Valeriana Jatamansi).
3 A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī, (Sphoeranthus molis?^1 ?)
E.
प्र before व्रज to go, aff. क्त.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-ज्या)
1 Roaming, travelling, wandering about, as a religious mendicant especially.
2 Abandonment of the world.
E.
प्र before व्रज to go, aff. यम.

m. (-तः)
An ascetic, who has broken his observance.
E.
प्रव्रज्या, and अवसित finished.

n. (-नं)
Banishment.
E.
प्र before व्रज to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

m. (-टः)
A body louse.
E.
प्रावार the outward garment, and कीट an insect.

n. (-ण्यं)
Cleverness, skilfulness.
E.
प्रवीण, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to wear.
E.
प्र and आङ् before वृ to wear, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-वृट्)
The rainy season, two months, about July and August.
E.
प्र before वृष to sprinkle, aff. क्विप् and the vowel of the prefix made long.

f. (-षा)
The season of the rains.
E.
प्रावृष् as above, and टाप् added.

f. (-णी)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
प्रावृष् the rains, फक aff.; growing in the rains.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Produced, &c. in the rainy season.
m. (-कृः)
A peacock.
E.
प्रावृष the rains, aff. ठक्.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in the rains.
E.
प्रावृष् in the 7th case, ज born.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्य)
1 Produced in the rains.
2 Much, abundant.
m. (-ण्यः)
The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.)
E.
प्रावृष the rains, and एण्य aff.
